title: Booking space in a pottery kiln

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I booked two small kiln spaces tonight for my cups. Could I also bring my wide serving plate?
turns.zh: 我預訂了今晚場次的兩個小窯位，要用來燒我的杯子。也可以帶那只寬餐盤嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It takes a full shelf. We hold the top shelf until five for any large piece booked in advance.
turns.zh: 餐盤佔整層。頂層留到五點，讓已預約的大型作品使用。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I’ll bring just the cups for now. Must I come back at five?
turns.zh: 我先只帶杯子來。五點還得再跑一趟嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Leave your number. If the shelf is free, I’ll call. Bring the plate before we load the kiln.
turns.zh: 留個電話。如果那層有空，我會打給你。裝窯前把餐盤送來。
